stories.title: Define prescription data schema and provider-condition mapping contract
stories.description: Design Pydantic models and MongoDB schema for ingesting prescribing datasets (e.g., Medicare Part D), including provider identifiers (NPI), drug codes, volumes, and mapping to condition taxonomy (ICD-10). Define normalized score contract output structure.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Requires new schema for prescription + condition mapping. GAP: No existing prescribing data schema or ICD-10 mapping contract defined in current codebase.

stories.title: Implement prescription ingestion and normalization pipeline
stories.description: Build backend pipeline to ingest raw prescribing data, normalize drug identifiers, aggregate by provider, and map prescriptions to conditions using ICD-10 loader and/or LLM-assisted mapping.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/icd10_loader.py supports condition taxonomy; ASSUMPTION: No existing prescription ingestion pipeline. GAP: Must build new ingestion + normalization flow.

stories.title: Develop prescribing appropriateness scoring algorithm
stories.description: Create core logic that evaluates provider prescribing patterns against expected condition-treatment mappings and produces a normalized appropriateness score. Incorporate AI/LLM synthesis for ambiguous mappings.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No existing scoring logic for prescription appropriateness. GAP: Must define scoring methodology combining data + LLM synthesis.

stories.title: Expose prescription behavior analysis via Evaluate Care API
stories.description: Add endpoint and service integration to expose prescribing scores and summaries through evaluate_care_facade, enabling downstream UI/chat consumption.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py shows pattern for exposing evaluation services; GAP: No prescription analysis endpoint exists.

stories.title: Add unit and integration tests for prescription analysis pipeline
stories.description: Implement tests covering schema validation, ingestion pipeline, scoring logic, and API endpoint. Include edge cases for missing or sparse prescribing data.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py and other tests demonstrate existing testing patterns; GAP: No tests exist for prescription analysis.
